item.content:encoded:
Organization: Chadbox

Status: searching

Compensation: gratis

Role: UI design and web design

Chadbox is open source lightweight, fast and secure code execution engine. Let’s you run untrusted code execution in secure sandbox environment. And our chadbox cloud API service, free community API for indie developers, students, and startups.

We are looking for a single product landing page for chadbox engine + our community cloud API service.

Target audience is tech, dev. Full creative freedom on theme design, branding, logo.

We will give you credit and special mention on main pages and repo.

How to Apply:

  • pranavbagalofficial@gmail.com
  • https://github.com/cryptomafiaPB/chadbox/issues/16
